summary: Datavault AI Inc. filed an 8-K reporting it issued warrants to Maxim Group LLC and agreed to cash fees and co-sales agent roles in a future ATM offering to settle a right-of-first-refusal overhang from a prior May 2026 equity issuance. The 2,727,272 participation warrants have a 5-year term and $0.6325 exercise price. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special-situation event is present; this is a routine issuer-equity structuring and settlement filing.
